findings.title: The smooth cutoff bounds in equation (7) are inconsistent
findings.source_claim: Smooth cutoff rises from 0 on [0,1/2] to 1 on [1,infinity), with 0<=zeta'<=4 and |zeta''|<=16; eta has reversed endpoints and the same absolute derivative bounds.
hypotheses: v vanishes at both endpoints by smooth matching

findings.decisive_evidence: v(t)<=16min(t,1/2-t), whose integral is exactly1. Equality of integrals forces equality everywhere with this nondifferentiable tent, contradicting v in C1. No such C2 cutoff exists. Exact rational area calculation executed with exit0.
findings.proof: Report Section3.1 gives a universal nonexistence proof, not a sampled failed candidate.
findings.impact: The preliminary numerical bound is false; actual inner curvature positivity does not use16, and outer annulus only requires a finite fixed second-derivative bound. Full local estimates and parameter order survive the explicit replacement, preserving Theorem1.1 conclusions and both entropy regimes.

problems.reasoning: Independent analytic check: v=zeta' has endpoints0 and is bounded above by16min(t,1/2-t), of area1. Since integral(v)=1, equality forces the nondifferentiable tent, contradicting C1. The trapezoid repair has ramp lengths1/12, plateau1/4 and height3, total area1; convolving at radius1/48 keeps support in[25/48,47/48], first derivative<=3 and second derivative<=36 after integration. Source pp6-7 show the inner curvature estimate uses only monotonicity, cutoff range and c2^2<=c1. In the outer annulus, h=1-c1 eta(r/r1)psi and psi<=1/2 yield a uniform finite C(r1)c1 bound independent of r2; the increased second-derivative constant can therefore be absorbed by the existing c1 choice before selecting r2,c2.
problems.counterevidence: A C1 tent derivative with a corner reaches16, but no C2/smooth cutoff does; the source explicitly requires C-infinity. The downstream construction only needs a finite auxiliary derivative bound, so the report establishes the same geometric conclusions with36. Minor is supported by that verified limited dependency, not by repair brevity.
